activity_summary: On the first of the flood, Gannet's tilt-boat took the company, six oars and himself at the stern. The paper went in first and driest, under the hoops, and the rolls went in oiled cloth. Garnish stayed on the chest of three books and sixty rolls. Gannet cast off with three pieces of news: the Queen at Windsor, ice at Kew, and a peace with Spain. You told him it was three again, and you did not correct him. You had it from yesterday that the court went up to Richmond, which is not Windsor. You had no peace to put in the boat. The frost on the gunwale was not news from Kew. You left his version on the water. The scarlet coats stayed folded on the basket. Nick was in the boat and did not sing.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the corner, refused the correction, and kept the livery on the basket.

entities.name: Davy Gannet
entities.context: Took the stern, named six oars and the first of the flood, and cast off with three stories.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Put the paper in first and counted heads instead of shillings.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked for a dry board and left the scarlet alone.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept Sam in the boys' place and noted that Nick was not singing.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Stayed on the chest until the oiled cloth was on.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Asked about ice, and asked where a boy stands in the boat.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: In the boat. The order on Nick was spoken of, and he did not need to speak it.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: In the boat, and not in the talk.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: In the boat, and not in the talk.

facets.activity: Saw the paper go in first on the tilt-boat

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Paper first, and driest, under the hoops. The rolls in oiled cloth.

quotes.speaker: davy_gannet
quotes.text: Westward ho! The Queen's at Windsor, there's ice at Kew, and they've made peace with Spain.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Three again, Davy. Row. I am not your corrector on a stair, and I will not become one in a boat.
